test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Mark or substance that is impossible to remove
solution: The correct answer is '**Indelible**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Indelible**'. • It means 'that cannot be removed or washed out'. (जो हटाया या धोया न जा सके; अमिट, अलोप्‍य, स्‍थायी) • *Example: **indelible **ink...* **Correct Answer:__** *Indelible.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Stained**: to leave a coloured mark that is difficult to remove. [धब्‍बा या दाग़ लगना (जो आसानी से साफ़ न हो सके)] • **Smudge**: to make something dirty or untidy by touching it. [किसी चीज़ को (छूकर) गंदा या मैला करना; धब्‍बे डालना] • **Incredible**: impossible or very difficult to believe. (जिस पर विश्‍वास करना असंभव या बहुत कठिन हो; अविश्‍वसनीय) 39:Tbf2, The correct answer is '**reminds**'.
